'''Tel Bollin City Hall''' was the city hall of [[Tel Bollin]], a [[City/Legends|city]] and the only major settlement of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]. The building was located in the center of Tel Bollin, near to the [[Miners' Guildhall]], a hub for Endregaad's [[Geode (rock)|geode]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]].<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
 
During the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|era]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lyssa Torel]] held a low-level bureaucratic position at City Hall. When a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly plague]] struck Endregaad<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> the government of Endregaad collapsed, and City Hall was largely abandoned. Torel remained hidden in one of the building's offices, surviving the crisis by living off [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies left behind by her former colleagues.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
